description: Combine explicitly stated fishing conditions, active verified recommendation rules, and published fishing knowledge. Accepts common trout species aliases; use rainbow_trout, brown_trout or brook_trout and a separate stocked flag when known. Reports missing information and refuses unsupported tactics; read-only.

current.description: slow, moderate, or fast; optional when not fishing a stream.

fishing_pressure.description: none, low, moderate, or high; heavy/heavily pressured also accepted.

habitat.description: stream (including river or creek), pond, or lake (including reservoir).

species.description: Canonical rainbow_trout, brown_trout, brook_trout. Also accepts ordinary names and stocked/hatchery/wild prefixes.

stocked.description: True for stocked/hatchery fish, false for wild fish. Omit if unknown.

temperature_description.description: cold or warm, when explicitly stated.

water_depth.description: shallow, moderate, or deep; qualitative only, not an inferred measurement.

water_temperature_c.description: Measured water temperature in degrees Celsius; alternative to water_temperature.

water_temperature_f.description: Measured water temperature in degrees Fahrenheit; alternative to water_temperature.

conditions.description: Optional explicitly supplied conditions. Use canonical values or documented aliases; omit unknown values. Do not guess.

name: fishing_intelligence
title: Level 3 Evidence-Gated Fishing Intelligence
